main_text.p: Et offeres illa,Esr.7.17. Hiph. הִקְרִיב Appropinquare fecit, vel juisit, Admovit, Obtulit. Præterit. הִקְרִיב Et admovit, scil. מַחֲנֵהוּ Castra sua, ut Aben Esra supplet, Exod.14.10. aut manet intransitivum, Appropinquavit: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ Et offeres ea, Exod.29.3. Futur. תַּקְרִיב לָלֶדֶת Quæ appropinquabit parere, propediem paritura, Jesa.26.17. וַיַּקְרֵב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי Et accedere fecit ex conspectu domus, id est, Recedere fecit, amovit, 2.Reg.16.14. Chald. Præt. וְהַקְרִבוּ Et obtulerunt, Esr.6.17. וְהַקְרִבוּהִי Et stiterunt, accedere jusserunt eum, Dan.7.13. Partic. מְהַקְרִבִין Offerentes, Esr.6.10.
קָרֵב masc. Propinquus, Appropinquans, Accedens; 1.Sam.17.41. Plural. אַתֶּם קְרֵבִים Vos propinqui hodie ad bellum, Deut.20.3.

קָרוֹב m. Propinquus, Propinquum, Prope, Loci & Temporis: וְהָיָה קָרוֹב אֵלַי Erit propinquus mihi, Gen.45, v.10. וְקָרוֹב לָבוֹא Prope est ut adveniat, Jesa.13.22. Aff. אֶת קְרֹבוֹ Propinquum suum, Exod.32.27. Plur. קְרוֹבִים Propinqui, Jes.33.13. Aff. קְרוֹבִי Propinqui mei, Job.19.14. Fœm. עִיר הַקְּרֵבָה Civitas propinqua, Deut.21.3. Plural. הַקְּרֵבוֹת Quæ propinquæ, Ezech.22.5.

קְרָב m. Prælium, Bellum: proprie Congressum, seu Conflictum denotat, est, magis Chaldaicum: לְיוֹם קְרָב Ad diem prælii, Job.38.23. Plur.Fœm. קִרְבָּן [?] Prælia volunt, Psal.68.31. Chald. קְרָב עֲבַד Gerebat bellum, Dan.7.21.

קֶרֶב masc. Medium, Intimum: Venter: Intestinum: Item In, Inter, Intra: בְּקֶרֶב אִישׁ וּקְרַב אִישׁ Et intimù viri, Psal.64. v.7. בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ In medio terræ, Gen.45.6. Aff. וְעַל־קִרְבּוֹ Et cum intestinis ejus, Exod.12.9. אֶל קִרְבָּנָה In ventrem ipsarum, Gen.41.21. Plur. cum Aff. וְכָל־קִרְבַּי Et omnia interiora mea, Psalm.103.1.

page.notes: Hebrew points are reproduced as far as they are legible on the scan; the vowel pointing in several Hebrew forms is uncertain and may not match the printed points exactly. The form marked [?] in the entry for קְרָב (Plur.Fœm.) is hard to read. Printed form "Gerebat" in the Chaldaic example is also uncertain. Printed spellings such as "Jesa.", "Esr.", "Psal." and "Psalm." are left as printed.
